messages.subject: 500k analysis - issues with only Sty or only Nsp files.
parts:
Hello all

I am repeating an analysis on some 500k chips. This analysis ran
smoothly the first time (late last year), but I am getting an error
this time. Following the steps on the page ' Total copy number
analysis (10K, 100K, 500K)', everything runs great until:

process(ce, verbose=verbose)
...

Error in list("process(ce, verbose = verbose, force = TRUE)" =
<environment>, :

The error appears when aroma.affymetrix reaches the .CEL file 'C1'.
This file does not have an Sty partner.

Have I missed something where I should stipulate that some CEL files

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] 500k analysis - issues with only Sty or only Nsp files.
parts:
Hi,

you've spotted a bug that was introduced with aroma.affymetrix v0.7.2
(2007-09-30) due to added validation tests. Basically, the sanity
tests were a bit to conservative.

I've committed a patch that hopefully fix the problem:

library(aroma.affymetrix);
downloadPackagePatch("aroma.affymetrix");

Let us know if it works.

Henrik
